instruction: Please disable the background cone icon in VLC's interface. I don't want to see the traffic cone when there's no video playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the VLC background cone icon. Evaluator uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify VLC config has qt-bgcone=0 (disabled).
metadata.verification: Verified that check_qt_bgcone checks VLC config file vlcrc for qt-bgcone setting. Default is 1 (enabled), task requires setting to 0 (disabled) via Tools > Preferences > Interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VLC config file (vlcrc) where qt-bgcone setting is stored
Metric correctly parses config file and searches for qt-bgcone= setting
Metric correctly handles default value (1=enabled) and compares against expected value (0=disabled)
Expected value '0' correctly represents disabled state for background cone icon
Evaluator provides complete coverage of instruction requirement to disable background cone
No postconfig needed as VLC config file persists after task completion
No edge case issues or logical gaps identified
